title: Quick French Pasta Bake
description: A simple, satisfying French-inspired pasta bake perfect for a weeknight meal. This comforting dish combines the flavors of Russia with the ease of a French recipe.

ingredients.name: Ground beef
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook to 160°F (71°C) for food safety

instructions: Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large pan, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks. Drain excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer. Let cook for a few minutes until heated through.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, meat sauce, and grated cheese.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with additional grated cheese.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top for a crunchy crust.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
